Notes for distribution:

.DWG external reference files:
External reference (xref) paths were removed, so all xref paths must be placed on the AutoCAD search path, a project search path or in the same directory as the root drawing.
eTransmit does not include files required by xrefs unless they are also required by the root drawing.  In particular, plot style tables and overlay xrefs that are not used by the root drawing are omitted

.PC3 printer configuration files:
Please copy these files to the AutoCAD Printer Configuration Search Path directory.
